description: A pure, dependency-free weiqi (Go) rules kernel -- five rulesets, SGF round-tripping, a semantic event layer -- paired with a real, tested client-side web app: Play (Capture Go vs. a scripted bot), Learn (interactive lesson player), and Read (compiled glossary). A competitive real-time/correspondence Play service against other humans is still declared, not built.

entryPoints.headless: apps/weiqi-kernel/src/index.mts (pure module export, no server needed)

entryPointsNote: Deployed to weiqi.561.group (Cloud Run service "weiqi", static apps/weiqi-web/public served via scripts/serve.mjs -- PORT/HOST honor the Cloud Run convention). npm run build && npm run serve inside apps/weiqi-web still serves the identical Play/Learn/Tsumego/Read pages locally at http://localhost:8080/ for development.
seedPolicyNote: The bot-play Capture Go mode has no seed policy of its own (the bot is a deterministic pure function of board state, not a seed); no Play-vs-human service exists yet to fix a daily/client-supplied seed policy.
statusNote: Polish-phase pass (2026-08-20): gradient/shadow/sheen stone rendering, shape-coded ko/last-move markers, a magnifier-and-cancel touch flow, live concept-recognition toasts with hover-card glossary links, and an SRS-scheduled tsumego trainer are real and tested (168/168). Honest gaps, not yet built: no captured-stones tray or live score display; a territory/ownership-heatmap renderer exists in board.mjs but is not wired to any live page; one wood board theme; no move-number-on-stone option. A competitive real-time/correspondence Play service against other humans is still declared, not built.
